evidence.quote: In each of the four cases, the measurement we relied on differed from the deployed system: in the detector head, padding and downscaling; in the width of the spines in an early OCR test; in whether the dictionary contained the answer; and in whether the page ran on a desktop or a phone.

A photo is first downscaled so that its long side is at most 1,600 px. A one-class oriented bounding box (OBB) detector finds the spines. Near-duplicate boxes are merged (Section 3.5), and the number of boxes scoring 0.4 or more is the book count. Each box is then cut out with a margin of 8% of its short side, rotated so that its long side is vertical, and upscaled if its short side is below 96 px.

Inside the crop, PP-OCRv5 finds text lines and the Korean PP-OCRv5 recognizer reads them; the reading direction is decided from recognition confidence (Section 4.3). Lines that match one of 34 publisher names are dropped, and the line with the tallest glyphs becomes the title query.

Matching normalizes the query, retrieves 50 candidates from a 50,000-book dictionary with character 2-gram and 3-gram BM25, and rescores them with string similarity plus a few rules (Section 5). Each spine ends in one of three states: confirmed (the dictionary entry is taken as the answer), review (candidates are shown and the user picks), or unmatched.

All three models run in ONNX Runtime Web 1.31.1 on the multithreaded WebAssembly backend inside a Web Worker. The app is a static site made of plain ES modules with no build step. Besides serving its files, the server has one optional endpoint, which forwards the title text of unconfirmed spines to a book-search API when the user asks for it (Section 5.5).

targetEvidence.quote: Reranking은 다음과 같이 작동합니다: 각 (쿼리, 응답) 쌍에 대해 관련성 점수를 부여합니다. 이름에서 암시하듯이, 응답이 쿼리와 관련성이 높은 경우 높은 점수를 부여하고, 그렇지 않은 경우 낮은 점수를 부여합니다. 이 장에서는 이 모듈에서 이전에 찾은 위키피디아 검색 결과를 개선하기 위해 재정렬을 사용하는 방법에 대해 배울 것입니다.

targetEvidence.quote: Object Detector는 Object의 coordinate를 찾고(Localization), class를 분류(Classification)하는 작업을 진행한다. R-CNN은 이를 순차적으로 진행하는 2 Stage Detector 로, 딥러닝을 적용한 최초의 Object Detector다. R-CNN모델은 Object Detection 혹은 Inference(추론)시, 아래와 같은 순서에 의해 동작한다.

sourceEvidence.quote: mAP50 is box mAP at IoU 0.5 on the 4TU validation set.

targetEvidence.quote: AP는 Faster R-CNN, SSD와 같이 객체탐지의 정확도를 측정하는데있어서 가장 인기있는 metric이다. AP는 0과 1사이의 값을 가지는 recall을 통해 average precision값을 계산한다. 꽤나 복잡한 얘기로 들릴수 있겠지만 예시와 함께 설명하고자한다. 그전에, precision, recall, IoU에 대해 알아보자.
